name: Database-count cost in the pinned Beads and Dolt write path
summary: Historical synthetic measurements for Beads 1.2.2 and Dolt 2.2.0 at source f615440: native and endpoint write/claim/checkpoint/review/merge costs at 1, 5, 10, 20, 35, 50 and 100 databases, captured SQL counts and catalog durations, and single release25/backup-all samples at 50 and 100. Two filtered migration-column checks recur on measured native writes; their duration grows with the catalog while ordinary-query and list/show controls remain comparatively flat. The report recommends retaining the 20-database default and route-specific estimates, and evaluates settings/versions, retired-database movement, multiple servers and operator-only count/latency warnings. This is measured investigation documentation, not an implemented speedup, a universal performance guarantee, a dependency upgrade, or a live-deployment/restore claim.
